subject: Northbridge renewal & expansion — request for credit/price-hold options
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@northbridge.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.com>
Cc: Northbridge Procurement <procurement@northbridge.com>
Date: 2028-10-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + expansion — pricing and credits ask

Lukas,

Our renewal is coming up (term ends 2028-11-30) and we want to expand usage across two additional product teams. Current commit: 3M tokens/month. Target request: 5M tokens/month for the next 12 months, with a backstop true-up at quarter end.

Before we proceed to legal/procurement, procurement has three asks they want us to discuss:
- Price hold at current effective rate for the first 6 months of the new term (we plan to scale quickly but want predictable cost to plan headcount)
- One-time onboarding credit to offset migration/testing costs (est. $18k)
- Invoice net-60 and an easy PO workflow — procurement will need a PO template attached to the contract

I've attached our Q3 usage report so you can see the ramp profile. Let me know what flexibility you have on price-hold + credits and if we can get a draft with redlines by next Wed so procurement can start the PO.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Director, Cloud Platform
Northbridge

Attachments: usage_report_q3.csv (csv)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@northbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-09T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion — pricing and credits ask

Samir — thanks for the clear asks and the usage file. Quick summary of what we can do and open items: 

1) Commit uplift options
   - Option A (preferred for predictability): 5M tokens/month committed for 12 months with a 12% volume discount vs current list; includes automatic quarterly true-up.
   - Option B (phased commit): Start at 4M/mo for 3 months, step to 5M/mo afterwards; slightly higher unit price but lower initial commit.

2) Price hold
   - We can offer a 90-day price hold at the current effective blended rate (applies to Option A or B). Extending to 6 months requires an offset: a one-time deployment/onboarding credit would need to be reduced or downstreamed via a phased step.

3) Onboarding credit
   - We can grant a one-time credit of $12,000 (applied against the first invoice) in the standard renewal package. If you require the 6-month price hold, we can bump the credit up to $18,000 conditionally if Northbridge signs a 12-month 5M commit (Option A).

4) Invoicing & PO
   - We can accommodate net-60 and accept PO-based billing; I will loop in our billing ops to confirm internal approvals.

Next steps I propose:
- I will attach a redlined term sheet with Option A and Option B clearly enumerated + the conditional $18k credit for a 12-month 5M commit.
- If that looks good, Marissa can approve a one-time concession (credit) and Ben can route the final to legal/procurement for an expedited DocuSign.

Samir — would Option A with the conditional $18k credit and a 90-day price-hold work as a starting point? If yes, I'll send the DocuSign link and a mutual action plan (MAP).

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redline_term_sheet.pdf (stub), proposed_map.docx (stub)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-10-10T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Northbridge renewal & expansion — pricing and credits ask

Team — forwarding Northbridge's renewal/expansion request. Key asks: 6-month price-hold, $18k onboarding credit, net-60 invoicing. I've proposed a compromise: conditional $18k credit if they sign a 12-month 5M commit; otherwise $12k credit + 90-day price hold.

Need decisions/approvals for:
- Concession cap (is $18k within what Finance will approve for this ARR band?)
- Whether we can make price-hold 6 months (revenue exposure + precedent) or we limit to 90 days.
- SLA exceptions (procurement asked about guaranteed latency targets across regions — should we surface Dedicated option?)

I've attached a quick finance impact snapshot. Preliminary projection: 12-month 5M commit with 12% discount + $18k credit reduces recognized ARR in year 1 by ~6% vs list but increases committed spend and reduces churn risk given cross-team expansion.

Can you both weigh in by EOD? Procurement wants a draft by Wed so their PO team can start.

Thanks,
Lukas

Lukas / Ben — quick: I can approve the conditional $18k onboarding credit tied to a 12-month 5M commit. Thoughts:
- Approve $18k as a one-time credit applied to first invoice.
- Limit price-hold to 90 days; agree to revisit a 6-month hold only if we secure a multi-year lock or higher ARR commitment.
- Legal: tighten the true-up language (net of cache/prefix caching assumptions) — we don't want ambiguous overage calculations.

Ben, please prepare the DocuSign with the conditional credit language and the 90-day price-hold. I'll coordinate escalations if procurement pushes for 6 months.

Marissa
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@northbridge.com>

Date: 2028-10-11T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge renewal & expansion — request for credit/price-hold options

Lukas — thanks for the quick turn. This path looks workable. Two quick clarifications before we hand this to procurement:
1) Northbridge will accept the 90-day price-hold tied to Option A (5M commit / 12 months) if the $18k credit is included and the true-up window is quarterly.
2) Procurement asks that invoices be Net-60 and that the DocuSign package include a standard PO addendum; I'll attach our PO template.

If you can send the DocuSign with the conditional credit and the PO addendum, procurement will start internal routing. Legal will want to confirm SOC2 references — can you include our SOC2 artifact link or attest?

Appreciate it — Samir
